# Psalm 86 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-prayer of-David. Incline O-YHWH your-ear, answer-me, for afflicted and-needy I-am.

**2** Guard my-soul for faithful I-am; save your-servant you my-God, the-one-trusting to-you.

**3** Be-gracious-to-me O-Lord, for to-you I-call all the-day.

**4** Gladden the-soul-of your-servant, for to-you O-Lord my-soul I-lift-up.

**5** For you O-Lord good and-forgiving, and-abundant-in-steadfast-love to-all calling-on-you.

**6** Give-ear O-YHWH to-my-prayer, and-attend to-voice-of my-supplications.

**7** In-day-of my-distress I-call-on-you, for you-will-answer-me.

**8** There-is-none like-you among-the-gods O-Lord, and-there-are-no-works like-yours.

**9** All nations whom you-have-made will-come and-bow-down before-you O-Lord, and-they-will-glorify your-name.

**10** For great you-are and-doing wonders; you-are God you-alone.

**11** Teach-me O-YHWH your-way; I-will-walk in-your-truth; unite my-heart to-fear your-name.

**12** I-will-thank-you O-Lord my-God with-all my-heart, and-I-will-glorify your-name to-forever.

**13** For your-steadfast-love great upon-me, and-you-have-delivered my-soul from-Sheol beneath.

**14** O-God the-arrogant have-risen against-me, and-a-band-of ruthless-ones seek my-soul, and-not they-have-set-you before-them.

**15** And-you O-Lord a-God compassionate and-gracious, slow-of anger and-abundant-in-steadfast-love and-faithfulness.

**16** Turn to-me and-be-gracious-to-me; give your-strength to-your-servant, and-save the-son-of your-maidservant.

**17** Do with-me a-sign for-good, and-let-them-see haters-of-me and-be-ashamed, for you O-YHWH have-helped-me and-comforted-me.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **86:11**: 'Unite my-heart' (yached levavi) — a prayer for inner coherence; the divided heart is the fundamental spiritual problem.

- **86:15**: Echoes Exodus 34:6 — the great self-revelation of YHWH's character: compassionate, gracious, slow-of-anger, abundant-in-chesed and emet.

— EMET
